That's right. I marked the potato and color-palettes ones as read later in a batch, and when I switched to the Read later filter all three showed up — those two plus the Kyoto one that was already flagged — giving 3 results. And my two picks were still selected, ready for another action.

Your assumption is exactly what I'd want: a "mark read later" batch should just switch it on. The Kyoto one that was already in my pile stayed put — it wasn't toggled off or disturbed just because it happened to already be marked. That's the sensible behavior; a batch "add to my pile" shouldn't accidentally un-pile something that was already there.

This is good. What's next?
